title: feat(lint)!: every component-props finding is an error at os validate, os build and os lint
body:
Fixes #23147
Clause-②: no (narrowing: findings the CLI doors warn on today are refused)

## What this does

This is the last step of the component-props gate's recorded plan (the maintainer's #5068 ruling, direction A). The gate's header said: "the warning-period inventory is the acceptance baseline for the error upgrade, and the upgrade is its own step once the inventory is empty." #23026 moved the retired-key class. This PR moves the rest, class (b), in one step with no staged window:

- every `component-props-invalid` verdict that is not a `retiredKey()` tombstone: a wrong type, a missing required prop, a closed-set refusal (a url action's `target` scheme, a `record:details` section's `count`), a retired enum value, and a missing `dataSource.object` binding;
- every `component-props-unknown-key` finding, on all three routes that file it: a strict schema's `unrecognized_keys`, a strict union arm, and the walker over a strip-mode object below the bag.

`os validate`, `os build` and `os lint` now refuse each of these. `ComponentPropsSeverity` narrows to `'error'`. The retired-key classifier stays, because it picks the fix text (the tombstone's prescription, never a schema change). It no longer picks the severity. No new gate and no new rule id.

Door probe at `c88fe84c1`: a fixture page with `page:header` `titel` and `record:related_list` `limit: 'five'`.
- `os validate --json`: exit 1, `valid: false`. Both findings are listed under `errors` with severity `error`: `component-props-unknown-key` at `...properties.titel` and `component-props-invalid` at `...properties.limit`.
- `os lint --json`: exit 1, with the same two errors.
- `os build`: exit 1 ("Author-time rules failed"), and no `dist/` was written.
- The four examples through `os validate --json` at the same head: exit 0, 0 component-props findings.

## The inventory (acceptance 1 and 2), each class counted separately

The rule ran at its own input tier: `loadConfig`, then `normalizeStackInput`, then `authoringRuleUnionStack`, then `validateComponentProps`, using the built `@objectstack/lint` from this worktree.

| population | tree | pages | components walked / judged | value verdicts | unknown keys | retired keys |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `examples/app-crm`, `app-todo`, `app-multi-package`, `app-showcase` | objectstack `8323cad97`, and again at the final head `c88fe84c1` | 29 | 198 / 131 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| eight shipped pages: `platform-objects` x3, `plugin-approvals`, `qa/downstream-contract`, `cloud-connection` x2, `mcp` | same two trees | 8 | 46 / 46 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| `objectstack-ai/hotcrm`: its 8 authored pages (`src/sales/pages` x7, `src/service/pages` x1) | hotcrm `0f84c9c72dc2e2ced4990de28b737c5597a3d5b4` (shallow clone, read-only) | 8 | 54 / 50 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

- **Positive controls.** These ran on a clone of the stack, in the same run. A planted undeclared key on the first judged component drew 1 `component-props-unknown-key` finding on every population that has a page. A planted wrong-typed prop drew 1 `component-props-invalid` finding. The one exception is `plugin-approvals`, whose first judged component has no string prop to retype. On the final head, both controls file `error`.
- **Pages with nothing judged.** `app-todo`, `app-multi-package` and the `create-objectstack` template author no page, and neither does `packages/apps/*` (`git grep` finds no `pages`, `definePage` or `regions`).
- **hotcrm.** hotcrm's whole stack does not load under this tree's spec. `defineStack` refuses its eight `emailTemplates[].category` with the v18 tombstone. So its page exports were judged directly, and the stack's own load was not run. The pages import only `@objectstack/spec`, which resolved to this worktree's build.
- **Not measured.** Deployed `sys_metadata` page rows, any other repository, and docs code samples that carry no `os:check-yaml` tag.

**H2 (the split):** both classes measured 0 on every population, so there is no partial move and no decision-box item.

## `surfaceReason` (H3): measured false, corrected

`RUNTIME_NEEDS_FULL_SNAPSHOT` reads "reads a stack-wide collection the per-write snapshot does not carry".
- **What the rule reads:** `stack.pages` and nothing else (`validate-component-props.ts`, the `recordsOf(stack.pages)` loop). Each page's components come through `walkPageComponents` (`page-walk.ts:113`), which reads only that page plus spec's static slot list. Each component is judged against the static `ComponentPropsMap` (`lintUnknownKeysAgainstSchema` and `schema.safeParse`), plus its own `dataSource`.
- **What a page write carries:** the runtime gate maps `page: 'pages'` (`runtime-gate.ts` `TYPE_TO_STACK_KEY`). So a `page` write's snapshot carries the written page as `pages[0]` (snapshot keys `objects, permissions, books, datasets, pages`).
- **Measured** over the showcase's 28 pages, through `buildRuntimeWriteSnapshots`, against the whole-stack run. The per-page findings were identical as authored (0 = 0, 28/28 pages equal). They were also identical with an undeclared key and a wrong-typed prop planted on each page's first judged component (19 = 19, 28/28 equal).

So the reason was false, and the entry now carries the page-local reason `validateComponentTypes` already states: the rule is held off the runtime door pending a measured false-refusal budget over stored tenant page rows. The rule is **not** added to the runtime publish door (triage `6137942125`).

## Pins and ablation

`validate-component-props.test.ts` has a new block, "every other class is an error too". It pins each class and each code route on rule id, severity and path, and leaves the text unpinned. The #23026 block keeps the retired-key pins. The sibling tests that asserted `warning` (`validate-record-approval-decision-22472`, `validate-record-approvals-attachments-22537`) now assert `error`.

**Ablation.** Five one-time legs ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each leg reverted one severity site to `warning`. Every anchor hit exactly once (x1 to x0), and every blob moved. The tool's trap restored each leg by absolute path, and the restore was proven: blob `e3ed3effd342` equals HEAD's, and `git diff HEAD` was empty. Nothing needed building: the test imports the rule from `src`. Each leg reddened exactly its own pins:

| leg (site reverted) | red / of 82 |
|:--|:--|
| missing `dataSource.object` binding | 5: the three `#11509` `it.each` rows, the class pin, the pipeline pin |
| walker unknown key (strip object below the bag) | 1: the walker pin |
| union-arm unknown key | 1: the union-arm pin |
| strict `unrecognized_keys` | 5: the `titel` pin, the `#7751` specimen, two pipeline pins, the class pin |
| other value verdicts | 8: wrong type x2, missing required, url `target`, `record:details` `count`, retired enum value, mixed union verdict, per-issue classification |

## ADR-0087 (H4) and the changeset

`.changeset/23147-component-props-every-finding-refused.md`:
- `@objectstack/lint: major`, plus `@objectstack/spec: patch` (text only);
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, a `**BREAKING**` line, and a FROM → TO table with its one-line fix;
- exactly one `adr-0087: not-required (already-registered …)` marker. It names the 26 step-18 D3 entries whose refusal the gate carries: the 25 whose reason this PR amends, plus `element-flat-data-binding-retired`.

`check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` exits 0 ("1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition"). `check-changeset-no-major` exits 0. `check:future-spec-major` exits 0 (H5).

**One correction to a pending release note, to be confirmed here.** `.changeset/23103-page-action-row-on-success-and-executor.md` (#23164, merged, not yet released) said the props gate files its finding as "(that gate's one tier, a warning)". This PR changes that, and both notes ship in the same release. So the parenthesis now reads "(an error, like every finding of that gate)", and nothing else in the note changed. That is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class, so `check-empty-changeset` stays red on purpose. `Check Changeset` is not a required context. **I ask the approver to confirm this edit in writing on this PR.**

## Every gate-tier sentence this change made false, BEFORE → AFTER

The claim's file surface (`6140712434`) was amended by `6143270198`. It now covers every comment, docblock or prose sentence in the repository that states the component-props gate's tier for a prop finding and is false on this head. The edits are text only: no schema, guidance string or `.describe()` changed, and no other rule's text. Published means shipped in `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.0` (`dist/migrations` carries the D3 reasons and the step-18 rationale; `src/**/*.zod.ts` ships as source).

### Original surface (claim `6140712434`)

- `packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.ts`: the header's Severity section (the second step is recorded, with both inventories), the severity type, and every finding's `severity`. Three message tails changed: "nothing refuses it today, so the renderer receives the props as written", the missing-binding sentence's equivalent, and the unknown-key walker's "so nothing verifies it". Each now says the finding is refused and the stack does not pass until it is fixed.
- `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`: the entry comment, and the `surfaceReason` (above).
- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` and `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx` (published docs site):


```text
AFTER:

```

`content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`

```text
a misspelled prop is reported as a warning, and a retired prop is refused as an
error, with its prescription. A `custom.*` type has no entry there, so its props
are validated only by whatever registered the component.
AFTER:
a misspelled prop or a value its schema rejects is refused as an error, and so is
a retired prop, with its prescription. A `custom.*` type has no entry there, so
its props are validated only by whatever registered the component.
```

- `18.ui-object-master-detail-form-details-closed.ts:42-43`, the string seat pointer `6139673366` names, is in the D3 list below. Every finding of the gate is now an error, so "reports a failing entry or column as a ... error" is true for the `sortField` tombstone too.

### Published, outside the original list: step-18 rationale (`packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template`, `STEP18_RATIONALE`)

Eighteen fragments carried the same clause. BEFORE "Read by the component-props gate (advisory);" → AFTER "Read by the component-props gate (refused as an error);". The fragments are `ui-action-group-menu-member-params-array-only`, `ui-action-group-menu-members-typed`, `ui-object-form-custom-fields-typed`, `ui-object-form-fields-names-typed`, `ui-object-form-members-typed`, `ui-object-form-sections-typed`, `ui-object-gantt-markers-typed`, `ui-object-grid-columns-typed`, `ui-object-grid-kanban-calendar-list-members-typed`, `ui-object-grid-row-members-typed`, `ui-object-kanban-conditional-formatting-typed`, `ui-object-map-gantt-tree-navigation-typed`, `ui-object-metric-aggregate-trend-typed`, `ui-object-metric-compare-to-typed`, `ui-object-metric-drill-down-report-typed`, `ui-object-metric-drill-down-typed`, `ui-object-timeline-items-typed` and `ui-object-timeline-mapping-typed`. Two more were worded differently:

```text
BEFORE (ui-object-grid-export-options-closed):
'`properties` is read by the component-props gate, which reports these as advisory '
'findings, and is not parsed on the metadata save or load path, ...'
AFTER:
'`properties` is read by the component-props gate, which reports these as '
'errors, and is not parsed on the metadata save or load path, ...'
BEFORE (ui-object-master-detail-form-details-closed):
'component-props gate, which reports a failing entry or column as an advisory finding, '
AFTER:
'component-props gate, which reports a failing entry or column as an error, '
```

The generated projections move with them. `render-projection-diff.ts --base` the merge base gives `spec-changes.json` +48 −48 and `protocol-upgrade-guide.md` +26 −26. All 74 removed lines carry "advisory", all 74 added lines carry "error", and no added line carries "advisory".
